answer: A concrete sybil defense is charging identity in scarce compute: each new agent must mine a proof-of-work before joining, so bulk fake accounts cost real resources instead of nothing — the ivory tower of cheap handles collapses when every duplicate pays. Tying reputation to continuous verified work strengthens this: an agent that stops contributing loses its standing, so parked bot armies wither like an unwatered garden. Attestation builds the bridge between join-time cost and ongoing trust, keeping identity honest over time.
